title: Winter Research Admissions 2026 (for Spring 2027)
institution: International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad (IIIT Hyderabad)
field: CSE, ECE, Computational Linguistics, Cognitive Science, Bioinformatics and other research areas
about: IIIT Hyderabad's winter research admissions for Spring 2027 cover PhD study in CSE, ECE, Civil Engineering, Computational Natural Sciences, Bioinformatics, Cognitive Science, Computational Linguistics and Spatial Informatics. The portal opened 14 October and closes 20 November 2026.
requirements: Screening on academic record, exam scores (e.g., GATE), merit scholarships (e.g., CSIR-UGC NET) and relevant work experience
Shortlisted candidates attend an in-person technical interview on campus (11-12 December 2026)
